title: Points Expiring at a Month-End Run: Computation — Service Accounts and Repair Orders
content:
**Clause.** On a Service Accounts and Repair Orders account, the points expiring at a month-end run are the aged points less the points already used, never below zero. A point is aged once more than the expiry period has passed since the date it was earned, counted in whole months from that date to the day the run is made (a whole month is complete on the same day of the following month, or on the first day of the month after it where that month has no such day), the expiry period being the tier's expiry period in months from the points terms; the points already used are every point ever redeemed and every point already expired on the account.

**The run.** The month-end run for a calendar month is due on that month's last day; a run not made on that day is made on the day it is made, and in either case points are aged, and every window and every count of whole months is taken, to the day the run is made; the expiry is booked as one points-expired entry dated on the day the run is made, carrying the month the run is for as its billing month; a run that finds no points expiring is made without an entry.

**Order of figuring.** The points expiring are figured in this order: first the aged points are found under the expiry period as every lengthening this policy sets out extends it; then the points already used are taken off; then every number of protected points this policy sets out is taken off; and the result is never below zero and never more than the points balance on file.

## Worked run (hypothetical, expiry period 12 months, run for April made on 30 April)
| Points-earned entry | Whole months to 30 April | Aged? |
|---|---|---|
| 1200 points, 14 February of last year | 14 | Yes |
| 800 points, 2 April of last year | 12 | No — not more than 12 |
| 600 points, 9 January of this year | 3 | No |

Aged points 1200; points ever redeemed 500, none expired before; points expiring 700, within the balance on file of 2100. One points-expired entry of 700 is dated 30 April with April as its month. Had the redemptions come to 1300, the result would be below zero, so no points expire and the run is made without an entry.
